native5.head: 3e9d922a7b36d9c092a2850923281f8cb08d4eb0
native5.body:
## Problem

Normal and delay-load descriptors ignore directory sizes, and bound descriptors, forwarder records and names can consume bytes after their directory. Partial metadata is consequently reported as complete imports.

## Changes

Frame all three import metadata readers by their declared directory and contiguous RVA mapping, require complete descriptor/forwarder records, and report truncation. Share the existing resource mapping-extent calculation without changing resource behavior.

The existing row-budget test overwrites .facts with 102 complete descriptors but leaves the old three-descriptor directory size. Updated only the declared size to 102 * 20, preserving its 408,000 requested rows and 200,000 output-cap assertion.

Invalid bound-forwarder names produce one warning per module, preventing repeated malformed records from multiplying identical diagnostic strings. Valid forwarder names are retained, and truncation remains visible.

## Regression coverage

6 regression and control tests in `crates/formats/tests/pe_import_directory_bounds.rs`. Short and partial descriptors, bound forwarder/name boundaries, selected-section extent, valid external names and the existing 200,000-row cap.

## Validation

Source revision `8a6017bd43b2eef263a645eafbac98b038763c20`, including a normal two-parent merge of upstream `efddbdeb6868f10a3d8d53f114d47aed72b89612`, passed formatting, the complete `craft-anything-formats` test suite, clippy with warnings denied, layer/lock/secret checks, L0–L2 WebAssembly checks, and the unchanged-lockfile check: [verification](https://github.com/Afloat16/claude-mem/actions/runs/42648202887/job/129267099134).

The new diagnostic regression failed before the correction at `943016fe3f242185981d1621e816f91ec6f00408`: 32 invalid forwarder names produced 32 identical warnings. It passes after coalescing those warnings per module. The original directory-boundary tests also reproduced four failures and one passing control against unchanged production code: [original baseline](https://github.com/Afloat16/claude-mem/actions/runs/42636776430/job/129226895499).

Current head `3e9d922a7b36d9c092a2850923281f8cb08d4eb0` adds only the status documentation after the tested source revision; [the comparison](https://github.com/Afloat16/craft-anything/compare/8a6017bd43b2eef263a645eafbac98b038763c20...3e9d922a7b36d9c092a2850923281f8cb08d4eb0) contains no source or test changes. Both the newer upstream parser changes and the existing 200,000-row assertion are preserved.

## Related work

#902 bounds optional headers, #903 resource directories and #1334 header RVA fallback. None bounds the import descriptor directories read by normal_imports, delay_imports and bound_modules.

## Scope

One R3.12 pending change, claimed in commit `5dbf2b5f94a4146c13d9765a31486ec31e25421d` before implementation.
native5.reply: Addressed in 8a6017bd43b2eef263a645eafbac98b038763c20. Invalid forwarder names now produce one warning per module while preserving truncation and valid forwarders. The regression reproduces 32 duplicate warnings before the change and verifies a single warning after it. The complete formats suite, formatting, clippy, layer/lock/secret checks, WebAssembly checks and lockfile check passed: https://github.com/Afloat16/claude-mem/actions/runs/42648202887/job/129267099134 . Current head 3e9d922a7b36d9c092a2850923281f8cb08d4eb0 adds only status documentation after that tested revision.

native10.head: ca995c780a255ded81ba7ffc72680839d47c302c
native10.body:
## Problem

Objective-C method decoding accepts nonzero strides smaller than the absolute or relative layout and publishes methods even when only a record prefix is backed by the section.

## Changes

Require a stride of at least 24 bytes for absolute records or 12 bytes for relative records, and require the complete declared record to be backed before decoding it. Preserve complete extended strides.

## Regression coverage

4 regression and control tests in `crates/formats/tests/objc_method_record_stride.rs`. Undersized absolute/relative strides, incomplete backed records, and standard/extended controls preserving selectors, types and implementations.

## Validation

Source revision `aaaac76ed1de9dda750128308f8fed0f6bce2457` passed `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, the complete `craft-anything-formats` test suite, and `cargo clippy --locked -p craft-anything-formats --all-targets -- -D warnings`: [verification](https://github.com/Afloat16/claude-mem/actions/runs/42636776430/job/129226891913).

The repository's complete existing CI also passed for that source revision: [CI run](https://github.com/Afloat16/craft-anything/actions/runs/42636344831).

The tests against unchanged production code reproduced 3 failures with 1 passing control: [baseline](https://github.com/Afloat16/claude-mem/actions/runs/42636776430/job/129226895499), revision `a100bb0647e191efa327867191fa508a49b8df2c`.

The original tested source `aaaac76ed1de9dda750128308f8fed0f6bce2457` is followed by completed documentation and a normal merge of upstream `efddbdeb6868f10a3d8d53f114d47aed72b89612`. Current head `ca995c780a255ded81ba7ffc72680839d47c302c` preserves the newer upstream parser work and both sets of roadmap/status entries. This PR's method-stride correction and regression fixtures are unchanged; the upstream CI checks the merged head.

## Related work

#205 checks method entry address overflow. This rejects too-small absolute/relative record layouts that overlap the next record, while preserving valid extended strides.

## Scope

One R3.12 pending change, claimed in commit `50d170d6829d3cc6d410d90f7376cf139d4393c4` before implementation.

native1_followup.head: ca4e03b2991ff6641a230f36e6b53b57047e2535
native1_followup.title: Preserve unambiguous ELF import slots across version-library metadata (R3.12)
native1_followup.body:
## Problem

A versioned ELF import has a library name, while `collect_symbols` records its GOT relocation slot without library metadata. The tuple-only association from #1365 can therefore leave an existing `JUMP_SLOT` or `GLOB_DAT` address unset.

## Changes

Preserve any explicit parser-provided slot and prefer a matching named-library slot. Permit an unlabelled-slot fallback only when both the candidate address and the import's library identity are unambiguous. Repeated relocation records for one address remain usable; different addresses or different version owners remain unknown.

The merged PE rejected-address guard is retained, so an invalid PE slot cannot be filled from another row.

## Regression coverage

Three additional integration regressions run through `parse_binary`: a versioned ELF with unique unlabelled GLOB_DAT/JUMP_SLOT slots, distinct possible slot addresses, and two same-named imports from different GNU version libraries sharing one unlabelled relocation. Existing PE library/slot identity controls remain in the same suite.

The missing-slot regression fails on `3ad1f5b0d33a336b744b6f653f85eb1635622422`. The two-library ownership regression fails on `f607786f68c16bdc85968ea35ec4ac76ff3d320f` before the final ownership guard. The fixtures verify that the parser actually reads both version-library identities and the expected relocation addresses.

## Validation

Exact source `1179870c55203d946bb8a7412b9b8f1088352fe3` passed formatting, the complete `craft-anything-formats` suite, clippy with warnings denied, layer/lock/secret checks, L0–L2 WebAssembly checks and the unchanged-lockfile check: [verification](https://github.com/Afloat16/claude-mem/actions/runs/42649963480/job/129273346728).

The initial missing-slot failure is preserved in [its before/after run](https://github.com/Afloat16/claude-mem/actions/runs/42648202887/job/129267099134); the final verification also proves the two-library ownership failure before the guard and passes all five import-slot integration tests after it.

Current head `ca4e03b2991ff6641a230f36e6b53b57047e2535` adds only completed roadmap/status documentation after the tested source; [the comparison](https://github.com/Afloat16/craft-anything/compare/1179870c55203d946bb8a7412b9b8f1088352fe3...ca4e03b2991ff6641a230f36e6b53b57047e2535) contains no source or test changes.

## Related work

Follow-up to merged #1365. It restores the valid versioned-ELF fallback without reintroducing same-named library reassignment. The branch includes upstream `efddbdeb6868f10a3d8d53f114d47aed72b89612` and preserves its newer native-parser corrections.

Claimed before implementation in `d3e6bf46c064bd4d4a28c5859ce60ecb1254fe6a`; the roadmap and status entry document this compatibility correction.
native1_followup.reply: Follow-up correction prepared on bugfix/r3.12-elf-versioned-import-slot-fallback-20261109. Named-library matches and explicit parser slots remain preferred; an unlabelled fallback now requires a unique import owner and a unique address. Three additional ELF integration regressions cover the missing valid slot and both forms of ambiguity. The complete formats suite, fmt, clippy and required L0 checks passed at 1179870c55203d946bb8a7412b9b8f1088352fe3: https://github.com/Afloat16/claude-mem/actions/runs/42649963480/job/129273346728 .
